To find the shortest time after which all three bulbs will be on at the same time, we need to find the least common multiple (LCM) of 2, 3, and 4.
The prime factorization of 2 is 2.
The prime factorization of 3 is 3.
The prime factorization of 4 is 2^2.
To find the LCM, we take the highest power of each prime factor that appears in the factorizations.
So, the LCM of 2, 3, and 4 is 2^2 * 3 = 4 * 3 = 12.
Therefore, the shortest time after which all three bulbs will be on at the same time is 12 seconds.
